entries.106752cd6d6bc2f7: This division develops, produces and sells excavating machinery such as hydraulic excavators and mini excavators, loading machinery such as wheel loaders, grading and roadbed machinery such as bulldozers and motor graders, haulage machinery such as dump trucks, forestry machinery, underground construction machinery such as shield machines, underground mining machinery, environmental recycling machinery, industrial vehicles such as forklifts, diesel engines, hydraulic equipment and castings, and also provides services for them. It also includes solution businesses such as the unmanned dump truck haulage system (AHS), the machine operation management system KOMTRAX, and the construction site management solution Smart ConstructionⓇ. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥3,806,040 million (up 0.2% year on year), segment profit was ¥491,118 million (down 18.0% year on year), and the number of employees was 61,960; both revenue and profit were the largest among the three divisions. As of the end of the period, the ICT construction machinery ratio in Japan, the United States, Europe and Australia was 28.7%, the cumulative number of AHS units introduced was 1,016, and the number of KOMTRAX-connected vehicles was 827,286.
entries.154a0809a3b6bff4: This is the division that handles forging machinery such as servo presses and mechanical presses, sheet metal machinery such as laser processing machines and press brakes, machine tools such as transfer machines and machining centers, defense-related products such as ammunition and armored vehicles, temperature control equipment such as thermo modules, and optical machinery such as excimer lasers for semiconductor exposure equipment. Komatsu Sanki, Komatsu NTC and Gigaphoton are responsible for this division. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥238,750 million (up 6.8% year on year), segment profit was ¥37,937 million (up 38.5%), and the number of employees was 4,276. The company cites higher sales of large presses for the automotive industry and increased maintenance sales in the excimer laser business for the semiconductor industry as the reasons for the increase.
